newsitem.title: USA: Coca-Cola to acquire Andina stake.
newsitem.headline: Coca-Cola to acquire Andina stake.

text.p: Coca-Cola Co. said Friday it agreed to acquire an initial 6 percent of Embotelladora Andina SA of Chile in exchange for two Argentine operations.
The agreement gives Coca-Cola the right to nominate an Andina director upon completion of the transactions, expected in December.
The pact "recognizes ... the potential for The Coca-Cola Co. to increase its ownership position in Andina to approximately 20 percent," the company said.
It said Andina would acquire INTISA Industrial y Commercial, a Coca-Cola owned bottler based in Cordoba, Argentina, and Compeljo Industrial PET.
CIPET supplies both returnable and nonreturnable plastic packaging to Coca-Cola bottlers in Argentina.
Coca-Cola's stock rose 37.5 cents to $50.50 early on the New York Stock Exchange.
